law: Hypothesis registry only: not CURRENT, QUEUE, priority, roadmap promise, feature debt or permission to create routes. One experiment may be ACTIVE.
promotion_gate: Same held object + one changed representation variable + invariant authority/action/RETURN/layout + observable benefit. RETAIN only after evidence; otherwise REVISE or PARK.
autonomous_rule: Machine work may remove confounds, test parity and measure non-degeneracy; it may not substitute for the declared human-perception gate or activate a dependent experiment early.

experiments.hypothesis: Atmospheric underpainting plus state-generated geometry can improve orientation/relationship perception without changing identity, lawful actions, witness, RETURN, authority or comparison layout.
experiments.one_variable: scene representation law: PLAIN vs PAINTING_LAW
experiments.negative_result: R1 invalidated: PAINTING alone had a 16:9 canvas, so the comparison confounded visual law with unequal vertical/layout weight. R2 gives both sides identical 16:9 scene bounds and resets local votes.
machine_gate: manifest-wide parity census has zero failures
experiments.pass: machine parity + human benefit + no next-action regression
experiments.stop: three R2 local comparisons or any semantic/authority/layout drift
